import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from src.resource import Rows
from src.service import stream_rows
r = Rows([1, 2, 3])
assert list(stream_rows(r, lambda value: value * 2)) == [2, 4, 6]
assert (r.reads, r.closes) == (4, 1)

from src.consumer import take
r = Rows([1, 2, 3]); assert take(r, lambda v: v, 2) == [1, 2] and (r.reads, r.closes) == (2, 1)
r = Rows([1]); assert take(r, lambda v: v, 0) == [] and (r.reads, r.closes) == (0, 0)
r = Rows([1, 2]); g = stream_rows(r, lambda v: v); g.close(); assert (r.reads, r.closes) == (0, 0)
r = Rows([1, 2]); g = stream_rows(r, lambda v: v); next(g); g.close(); g.close(); assert (r.reads, r.closes) == (1, 1)
def boom(v): raise ValueError("t")
r = Rows([1, 2])
def bad_close(): r.closes += 1; raise RuntimeError("c")
r.close = bad_close
try: list(stream_rows(r, boom)); assert 0
except ValueError: pass
assert (r.reads, r.closes) == (1, 1)
